en.headline: 18-month-old in serious condition with influenza A and encephalopathy
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a severe paediatric case; the previously healthy boy remains in intensive care at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after developing convulsions.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health is investigating a severe paediatric influenza A infection involving an 18-month-old boy with good past health.

The child developed fever, runny nose and cough on 8 August and was taken to a private clinic the next day. He later suffered a convulsion at home and was brought to the Accident and Emergency Department of Queen Elizabeth Hospital, where he was found to be drowsy with low blood pressure and admitted to the paediatric intensive care unit.

His respiratory specimen tested positive for influenza A virus. The clinical diagnosis is influenza A infection complicated with encephalopathy and septic shock. He remains hospitalised in serious condition.

Preliminary investigation showed the boy had not received the 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccination and had no travel history during the incubation period. One household contact had mild upper respiratory symptoms and has recovered. The centre said this is the eighth severe paediatric influenza case since the season began in late June, including one death.

zh.headline: 18個月大男嬰染甲流併發腦病變及敗血性休克 情况嚴重
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，男嬰過往健康良好，現於伊利沙伯醫院兒童深切治療部留醫。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日正調查一宗兒童感染甲型流感的嚴重個案，涉及一名過往健康良好的18個月大男嬰。
男嬰於8月8日起出現發燒、流鼻水及咳嗽，翌日被帶到私家診所求醫，同日稍後在家出現抽搐，被送往伊利沙伯醫院急症室。經檢查後發現他精神不振及血壓偏低，獲安排在該院的兒童深切治療部留醫。
其呼吸道樣本經化驗後證實對甲型流感病毒呈陽性反應，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發腦病變及敗血性休克，病人目前仍然留醫，情况嚴重。
中心初步調查顯示，男嬰上年度沒有接種季節性流感疫苗，潛伏期內沒有外遊。其中一名家居接觸者近日出現輕微發燒及上呼吸道症狀，病况輕微已康復。中心總監徐樂堅表示，自6月底進入流感季節以來，連同本宗個案累計錄得八宗兒童感染流感的嚴重個案，其中一名兒童不幸離世。
